description: Real, severe stack overflow inside a function that is never reachable from the reset vector, main(), or any IVT entry (exceptions/IRQs). Tests the static reachability pre-filter from the prompt's pipeline step 2.

cases.reason: No call edge exists from Reset_Handler/main or any of the 8 vector-table entries (NMI..SysTick, IRQ0..IRQ7) to dead_vulnerable_function. Static CFG reachability analysis (built from ALL entry points, not just main) must classify this as unreachable and short-circuit before emulation, per the pipeline's fast-triage design.
cases.notes: IMPORTANT: this must be refuted via the CFG/xref graph, not by observing 'the emulator never got there in one run' -- the latter is not proof of unreachability.

cases.reason: service_loop is called from main, but an unconditional branch skips the overflowing stores; no path inside the function reaches them.
